target_customer: High-growth startups hiring engineers and other roles
problem: Startups spend many hours sourcing, contacting and screening candidates, and juggle recruiting tools or pay agency fees.
business_model: Usage-based pricing by number of searches, positioned at about half the cost of a traditional sourcer (company site)
product_category: AI recruiting agent and recruiting operating system

founders.name: Victor Luo
founders.background_notes: YC page: ex ML scientist at TikTok.

founders.name: Zhuang (Gary) Luo
founders.background_notes: YC page: ex MLE at Meta and TikTok.

founders.name: Huimin Xie
founders.background_notes: YC page: ex tech lead and senior MLE at TikTok.

competitors.name: Juicebox
competitors.what: AI recruiting and candidate sourcing platform
competitors.funding_then: $30M Series A led by Sequoia in September 2025 per Sacra

competitors.name: Paraform
competitors.what: Agentic hiring platform combining human recruiters with AI

competitors.name: Mercor
competitors.funding_then: $350M Series C at $10B valuation, October 2025, per one source

technical_complexity.rationale: Multichannel outreach, candidate ranking and agent workflows are standard LLM and recommender engineering; founders have recommendation system backgrounds from TikTok and Meta.

defensibility.rationale: Learned hiring preferences and integrations add some lock-in, but funded rivals offer similar sourcing and customers report switching between tools.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action aimed at Perfectly found as of the sources reviewed.

market_need_then: Customer testimonial on the company site says a startup moved off Paraform and canceled Juicebox; the company reports 4x faster hiring and 10x candidate volume (self-reported). Rivals raised large rounds in 2025, showing demand.

branding.domain_note: Uses perfectly.so, a .so domain rather than .com.

identity.mascot_or_character: Paul, the AI recruiting agent persona, described as a super employee rather than a tool
identity.voice_and_tone: confident, persona-led; positions the agent as a teammate

branding.brand_signature: Paul, the named recruiting agent persona, plus companion Parker for candidates
branding.community_and_virality: Won Product Hunt Launch of the Day on 2026-03-13 per a profile; Perfectly team presented at YC Demo Day W26 per company site.

brand_strength.rationale: The named agent Paul gives a memorable persona, but the generic name is confusable with other companies called Perfect or GoPerfect.

outcome_analysis: Perfectly is an active Winter 2026 company with no exit. It claims early traction with startups that switched from Paraform and Juicebox, and won Product Hunt Launch of the Day, but those claims are self-reported. The market is crowded with well funded AI recruiting rivals, and its funding and later outcome are unknown.
notes: Unverified funding: aggregators list $500K (Jan 2026, YC) while EveryDev lists $130K; no primary source, so no round recorded. Competitor figures come from aggregator pages and a Sacra snippet and are unverified. Product Hunt launch date from a search snippet. Outcome search found nothing about shutdown or acquisition. Unrelated companies named Perfect (the Israeli $23M seed) were excluded. Completeness pass: one round recorded on the strength of a single database or outlet, VCBacked and NeuronFeed (NeuronFeed labels it seed); EveryDev lists 130K instead. No primary announcement found.
